note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 126-139; Bookmark #11: Public education, lines 680-721) lowercases every column and renames P05A01, P05A01A1..A11, P05A01B to pe_p05a01, pe_p05a01a1..pe_p05a01a11, pe_p05a01b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 111-123) labels each column, 13/13, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P05A01; P05A01A rows 1-11; P05A01B). Step 3b: live items (13, resp 1-10) match the questionnaire's public-education block exactly; no instrument mismatch. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.6 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi), not the dictionary labels: 10/13 dictionary labels are character-identical to the questionnaire; dictionary label variants not shipped (the dictionary drops the questionnaire's gender-inclusive forms and rewords A8): A7 dictionary 'maestros' vs questionnaire 'maestros(as)'; A8 dictionary '¿Los salones a los que asiste el alumno tienen pocos estudiantes para que pueda tener mejor atención?' vs questionnaire '¿Los salones a los que asiste tienen pocos estudiantes para que el (la) alumno(a) pueda prestar mejor atención?'; A9 dictionary 'los egresados sean aptos' vs questionnaire 'los(as) egresados(as) sean aptos(as)'. Printed line breaks (P05A01 stem, A9, A11, B) joined with a single space; wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page image are typesetting, and the PDF text layer and the dictionary label both have single spaces, as shipped. Structure: P05A01 (household member attended a public education centre in 2024, yes/no; this is also the screener for the school-nutrition block P05A01C/D, shipped separately as guatemala_2024_homes_nutrition) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P05A01A lead-in 'En el establecimiento público al cual asistió o asiste, la educación pública:' is shared by A1-A11 -> section_prompt of section _2; P05A01B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the skip instruction 'PASE A PREGUNTA P05A02' not shipped. Options as printed: P05A01 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A11 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A11 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P05A01B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number; 98 labelled 'No sabe / no responde'); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Skip pattern: P05A01=2 (NO, 4,263 households) routes to P05A02; in the source xlsx exactly those 4,263 are blank on A1-A11 and B, and all 2,623 P05A01=1 households are non-blank on all twelve. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 45/45 valid item x resp cells equal (p05a01 1/2 = 2623/4263; a1 1/2/3 = 1725/879/19; a2 1923/635/65; a3 2321/244/58; a4 702/1792/129; a5 2268/328/27; a6 2125/447/51; a7 2288/272/63; a8 1683/839/101; a9 2211/309/103; a10 2352/240/31; a11 106/2487/30; b 1..10 = 57/14/23/35/173/96/197/464/401/1052) and all 12 NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a11 4263 each, b 4263+111=4374. Live: 89,518 rows (= 13 x 6,886), 6,886 ids, 89,518 distinct id-item, 51,267 NULL resp (57.3%).
